## What changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link any related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For interface changes, include a screenshot.
For parser or scanner changes, include a fictional fixture that exercises the change.

## Evidence and privacy

If relevant, explain changes to source coverage, disclosure classification, permissions,
network requests or local storage. Keep public declarations, general COI notices and
unverified payment concerns distinct.
